req.title: PUT /players/{id} requires body
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when PUT /players/{playerId} is called without a request body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a PUT request to update a player must include a request body. If the body is missing, the server should respond with HTTP 422. This ensures that the API enforces the presence of necessary data for updates, maintaining data integrity.

tests.name: test_put_player_with_body
preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/1 with a valid request body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

valid_payload = {
    "firstName": "Anjali",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Banerjee",
    "dateOfBirth": "1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Goalkeeper",
    "abbrPosition": "GK",
    "team": "Manchester City",
    "league": "Premier League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1", json=valid_payload)
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_put_player_without_body
preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/1 without a request body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1")
assert response.status_code == 422
